postal_system.full_code_rule: Preserve PSČ as five digits rendered NNN NN, including leading zeroes. Česká pošta assignment, RÚIAN address identity, building geometry and any derived surface remain independent evidence.
postal_system.postcode_area_rule: Česká pošta postcode and address exports establish routing assignments, not nationwide official postal polygons. A surface generated from RÚIAN address points may be published only as opt-in derived_geometry with its method, release and uncertainty.
postal_system.address_rule: Use the RÚIAN address-place code as the stable civic-address identity and preserve municipality, municipal district, municipality part, street, building number, orientation number, PSČ, definition point, validity and source edition. A definition point is not a building footprint.
postal_system.building_rule: Promote RÚIAN VFR or INSPIRE building geometry as an exact building only through the source-defined parent Stavební objekt code, ISKN building identifier or a reviewed explicit crosswalk. Point containment and nearest distance are candidate evidence only.
postal_system.admin_rule: Use RÚIAN territorial identifiers and boundaries for country, region, district, ORP, municipality and cadastral context. Administrative geometry never becomes postal geometry.
postal_system.reference_status_rule: VDP is a free informational publication surface. Claims requiring legally referenceable basic-register data must use the authorized reference-system path and retain that status separately.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Public AGID resolution may display public civic-address and building context but excludes recipient, resident, owner, forwarding, shipment, customer and non-public register data.
postal_system.rights_rule: Pin every Česká pošta and ČÚZK artifact, source date, digest, attribution and license. Public RÚIAN open data remains CC BY 4.0 attributed; postal infrastructure or customer outputs without an explicit redistribution grant remain isolated.
postal_system.territory_rule: The CZ pack covers Czech sovereign territory. Cross-border routing and foreign addresses remain in their sovereign country packs.

exception_classes.rule: Keep Česká pošta PSČ-to-address or PSČ-to-locality assignment as non-geometric routing evidence unless independent geometry authority is pinned.
Represent PSČ assigned to a specific address, organization or addressee as a non-area record; never invent a surrounding residential polygon.
Represent post offices and other facilities as points or non-area routing records unless an authoritative source supplies a geographic area for that exact class.
Preserve Česká pošta no-delivery-service classification and never turn it into a deliverability claim.
Preserve the RÚIAN address-place code, source edition, definition point and validity; do not present its point as a building outline.
Use a source-defined parent building code, ISKN building identifier or reviewed crosswalk for exact linkage. Containing and nearby buildings remain candidates.
A Voronoi, union, hull, interpolation or administrative clip generated from RÚIAN address points is derived_geometry, opt-in and never branded as a Česká pošta official polygon.

quality_gates.pass: Every artifact has a pinned release or retrieval receipt, digest, provider, license, required attribution, schema, CRS and transformation method.
Česká pošta assignment, RÚIAN address identity, RÚIAN building geometry, administration, derived surfaces and AGID indexes remain separate evidence.
Geometry is valid, clipped to Czech territory and checked for unexplained overlaps, gaps, islands, invalid PSČ, multipart loss and national-border leakage.
Every code is classified as address/locality routing, addressee/organization, postal facility, no-delivery-service, derived-area-eligible, historical or unknown.
Every promoted address preserves its RÚIAN code, parent territorial and building references, address numbers, PSČ, definition-point lineage, validity and release.
Every exact address-to-building edge has a source-defined building code, ISKN identifier or reviewed explicit crosswalk; containment and proximity remain candidates.
Informational VDP evidence is not represented as legally referenceable basic-register evidence.
Public results contain no recipient, resident, owner, forwarding, shipment, customer or non-public register attributes.
Synthetic fixtures validate behavior but never satisfy production gates.

stages.definition: Source roles, PSČ classes and legal blockers are inventoried.
Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.
Pinned rights-reviewed snapshots reproduce experimental packs with full lineage.
Topology, identity, privacy, reference-status, freshness and holdout gates pass.
Two source refreshes pass and monitored rollback operates.
